reply: Done. The dashboard is now near black with no blue tint, set in Saans and Saans Mono, with a minimal layout. Note: your Saans files are trial fonts for personal use only, so they stay in the dashboard and never go into the game.
Planned as Phase 0. The base layer gets rebuilt from scratch with tests; nothing from the old code is trusted without a check.
The salvage audit is P0-003 (deep model run). It covers keep, rewrite or drop, with evidence.
Style discovery: a stand-in Delhi street scene, two batches of style tests side by side with measured frame times, then rounds with you until you sign off.
Architecture discovery: four measured benches (renderer and textures, physics worker, data and tiles, lane roads and terrain), then a table with numbers and a recommendation for you to sign off.
Agreed. After sign-off, art, texture and sound needs become dashboard cards with prompts. The style bible sets the prompt anchors.
No mirror anywhere. P0-001 adds the projection with tests: Connaught Place and Red Fort must land at their real positions, north is -Z, and colliders must match what you see.
The map repair layer and its pilot area are in the architecture options and the data bench. You sign it off together with the architecture.
The lane-level road model gets its own deep-model bench prototype in P0 (P0-019) and becomes the top build task after sign-off.
The map inspector is in the architecture options and is planned as an early P1 task, right after the architecture sign-off.
Added game design discovery as a third Phase 0 sign-off: options doc, interview rounds, sign-off, then GAME.md. No mission system before you sign off.
